q: There are several practical uses of static electricity in our daily ____.
e: There are several practical uses of static electricity in our daily life. Electrostatics is charge at rest. Like charges push apart.

q: Photocopier, electrostatic paint spraying, electrostatic precipitator etc., are based on static electric ____.
e: Photocopier, electrostatic paint spraying, electrostatic precipitator etc., are based on static electric charges. The physics in this sentence is built around charges.

q: Basic operation of a photocopier is the attraction of charged toner (ink) to the region on the selenium coated drum that is ____ charged.
e: Basic operation of a photocopier is the attraction of charged toner (ink) to the region on the selenium coated drum that is oppositely charged. The physics in this sentence is built around oppositely.

q: The item to be painted receives the negative charge from a negatively charged ____.
e: The item to be painted receives the negative charge from a negatively charged electrode. The physics in this sentence is built around electrode.

q: The droplets of paint emerge from the spray gun are ____ charged.
e: The droplets of paint emerge from the spray gun are positively charged. The physics in this sentence is built around positively.

q: As the droplets all carry the same charge they repel and spread out forming a fine ____.
e: As the droplets all carry the same charge they repel and spread out forming a fine spray. The physics in this sentence is built around spray.

q: The paint droplets are attracted to the surface of the ____.
e: The paint droplets are attracted to the surface of the frame. The physics in this sentence is built around frame.

q: The paint is attracted statically to metal frame from every direction so there is no ____ of spray paint.
e: The paint is attracted statically to metal frame from every direction so there is no waste of spray paint. The physics in this sentence is built around waste.

q: The waste smoke, dust and fly ash are passed through a negatively charged mesh of wire in the chimney and the fly ash particles become ____ charged.
e: The waste smoke, dust and fly ash are passed through a negatively charged mesh of wire in the chimney and the fly ash particles become negatively charged. The physics in this sentence is built around negatively.

q: Higher up the chimney these charged particles are attracted and stick to positively charged metal ____.
e: Higher up the chimney these charged particles are attracted and stick to positively charged metal plate. The physics in this sentence is built around plate.

q: The clean smoke is then released into the ____.
e: The clean smoke is then released into the atmosphere. The physics in this sentence is built around atmosphere.
